proposalsTable.intro: Tick a row's first box to accept it when you apply, or Never suggest so it is never suggested again. Rows scoring at least the threshold start ticked to accept. A row with neither box ticked stays undecided.
proposalsTable.applied: {{accepted}} accepted, {{notAgain}} not to be recommended again.
proposalsTable.none: This run has no proposal left to decide.

reason.invalid_shape: Not a relationship as asked for: a field is missing or has the wrong form
reason.unknown_column: Names a table or column the request did not compare
reason.not_comparable: The two columns have different classes, so they are not compared
reason.below_threshold: Scored under the {{threshold}}% a suggestion is kept at.
reason.out_of_scope: Outside the chosen source and target tables

proposalsTable.thresholdHint: Your own threshold, kept for your next runs.

measure.inTarget: {{found}} of {{values}} source values in the target.
measure.inTargetFirst: {{found}} of the first {{values}} source values in the target.
measure.inSource: {{found}} of {{values}} target values in the source.
measure.inSourceFirst: {{found}} of the first {{values}} target values in the source.

notRead.source: The source was not read: its table requires a parameter.
notRead.target: The target was not read: its table requires a parameter.

notReadable.source: You cannot read the source column.
notReadable.target: You cannot read the target column.

measure.modelScore: Scored by the model: no values were compared.
measure.ruleForeignKeys: Produced by a declared foreign key: no values were compared.
measure.ruleKeyNames: Produced by a matching key name and type: no values were compared.

proposalsTable.dimensionMade: Accepting makes the shared dimension {{name}}, which both columns join.
proposalsTable.dimensionJoined: Accepting joins both columns to the shared dimension {{name}}.
proposalsTable.twoDimensions: Its columns already join two different shared dimensions, so it cannot be accepted.
proposalsTable.admittedOnKeyValues: Admitted on key values matching in the data; the measure is shown beside the model's confidence.
proposalsTable.hiddenByFilter_one: {{count}} row is hidden by the filter.
proposalsTable.hiddenByFilter_other: {{count}} rows are hidden by the filter.
